quick_skim.title: Exact Quantile Balancing and Load-Error Injection for Mixture-of-Experts
quick_skim.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training requires global load balance to prevent expert under-utilization and local balance for efficient expert-parallel execution. Existing distributed Quantile Balancing (QB) uses shard-dependent or approximate global quantiles, while token-independent expert biases cannot ensure microbatch-level balance. We introduce Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB), which computes exact global-batch BF16 quantiles with negligible communication, and Load-Error Injection (LEI), which injects local load errors directly into router-score gradients. On 7.5B-parameter MoEs trained for up to 500B tokens, EQB improves global balance and downstream performance over naive QB, while LEI improves local balance and outperforms the GShard loss at comparable quality.

EQB computes exact global-batch BF16 quantiles with little communication, and LEI injects local load errors into router-score gradients, improving balance and downstream performance on 7.5B MoE models.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 混合专家训练需要全局负载均衡以避免专家利用不足，同时需要局部均衡以支持专家并行。作者提出精确分位数平衡 EQB 与负载误差注入 LEI，前者以极低通信量计算全局批次的 BF16 精确分位数，后者把局部负载误差注入路由分数梯度。在训练至500B token的7.5B参数 MoE 上，两者分别改善全局与局部均衡并提升下游性能，为动态专家路由的稳定性提供支持。
